visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female creator with short black hair is seen in a close-up shot. She has white moisturizing eye patches under her eyes. She is speaking enthusiastically into a large professional black condenser microphone. The background is a softly lit indoor room with shelves containing cute figurines and books. (2) The scene transitions to a medium shot of the same woman standing in an airy living room with light wood floors. She is wearing a light blue short-sleeved t-shirt and white casual pants. She gestures with her hands towards the camera, demonstrating the fit and fabric of the garment. The room is filled with bright, natural daylight. (3) The woman demonstrates the versatility of the shirt by wearing it backward to reveal a split-back detail. She hugs herself playfully and then spins around to show how the fabric drapes. The camera remains static at eye level, capturing her full upper body as she moves energetically. (4) The creator shows the shirt's high-low hemline and loose silhouette. She pulls at the hem to demonstrate the material's elasticity. Various text overlays in yellow and white appear around her to highlight specific features like "breathable" and "lightweight." She continues to pose and smile at the camera. (5) The woman ties the back of the blue shirt into a stylish knot, instantly changing the garment's shape to a more fitted waist style. She strikes several energetic poses with "V" hand signs. A static product image appears briefly showing the shirt on a professional model with detailed purchasing information.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female speaker introduces the brand "Lululemon" with a very high-pitched, enthusiastic rising intonation. An upbeat, high-tempo electronic pop BGM starts immediately, featuring a driving synth bass and sharp snare hits. The voice quality is clear and professional but highly animated. (2) A sharp digital "pop" sound effect occurs simultaneously with a visual transition. The speaker describes the "three ways to wear" the item in a friendly, conversational tone with moderate speech rate. The background music remains steady, providing a high-energy rhythmic bed underneath the clear, well-articulated vocal track. (3) The speaker emits a series of rhythmic, melodic "Ooh" vocalizations that sync with the beat of the music. A distinct "whoosh" transition sound effect is heard as the scene changes. The ambient room noise is minimal, indicating a high-quality studio-style vocal recording with no audible distortion. (4) The vocal delivery shifts to a descriptive narrative, emphasizing the comfort and "naked feel" of the fabric. The speaker's voice shows high emotional arousal and positive valence. A subtle "ding" sound effect highlights the appearance of feature labels on screen while the BGM maintains its driving energy. (5) The audio reaches a peak in density as the speaker repeatedly shouts "Buy!" in a rhythmic fashion. These vocal bursts are perfectly synchronized with a series of quick "impact" sound effects. The track concludes with a final energetic phrase and a sharp fade-out of both music and voice.
